title: Illustration use / Winter scene with short copy

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Match illustration density to the amount of text so a brief message can remain spacious.
strategic_value: A blue cabin and sled scene can establish a Helsinki winter setting without a full-page collage.
demonstration: A heading and one paragraph occupy the upper left on pale blue; a cabin and sled-pulling figure fill the right, leaving open space below the copy.
practical_value: Use one coherent scene when the text is short and the seasonal context matters.

content_islands.name: Short copy
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and single paragraph in the upper-left area.

content_islands.name: Winter scene
content_islands.spec: Group the cabin and pulling figure at right with the sled extending toward the center.

reference_purposes.Application: The slide combines short copy with one related winter scene.
reference_purposes.Expression: Blue architecture and bundled figures establish the seasonal character.
